title: You owe €1.6500000000000004
ticket: Splitting a €10 pizza order six ways asks the last person for €1.6500000000000004, and the payment provider rejects it.
explanation: Money is handled as binary floats. 1.67 has no exact float representation, so the sum of six shares is slightly off, and the fix-up for the last person inherits that error and shows it: 1.6500000000000004. Work in whole cents, as integers, and only format as euro at the end.
